note: One policy for the licence gates. allowed_licences is the WP1-01 allowlist, the same list as the root deny.toml. scan_roots are the trees the marker and provenance scans cover. Restricted-licence markers (AGPL, GPL, LGPL, MPL, SSPL, BUSL, FSL, commercial) are accepted only in the founder-decision allowlists (docs/orcel/notices/fd06-files.txt, fd04-files.txt), in isolated components, or in a marker exception below that names the file, the licence families and the reason. npm packages outside allowed_licences are accepted only by a named exception.
isolated_components_note: An isolated component is a locally operated unit in its own directory (its own Cargo workspace or npm package), never a member of the root Cargo workspace or the root npm workspaces, and never depended on by a crates/* unit (crates/orceld/tests/dependency_direction.rs). Restricted-licence code that cannot enter the core (C-15, C-17; founder decision 2026-11-17) may live only there. Entry shape: {"path": "apps/<name>/", "families": ["AGPL"], "attestation": "<id in donor-provenance.json attestations>", "reason": "..."}. Its donor files still need provenance entries.
